report:
# IBEX 35 Quality-Growth Screen — Executive Research Report

**Screen criteria applied:** ROE > 20%, P/E < 20, Debt/Equity < 100%, RSI(14) > 30, Price > 50-day MA
**Companies passing all five filters:** Amadeus IT Group (AMS.MC), Logista (LOG.MC), Laboratorios Rovi (ROVI.MC)

**Note on research depth:** Web searches for each ticker returned mostly generic financial-portal listings (Yahoo Finance, Reuters, Danelfin quote pages) rather than substantive news articles. Beyond a couple of specific data points flagged below, there was little incremental qualitative information to add. The analysis therefore relies primarily on the screened fundamental and technical metrics provided, supplemented only by what the searches actually surfaced.

---

## 1. Amadeus IT Group, S.A. (AMS.MC) — Technology

**Fundamentals:** ROE 26.47%, ROA 9.64%, P/E 19.01, Debt/Equity 78.6%
**Technicals:** RSI 57.72; price €57.60 vs. MA50 €53.93 (≈6.8% above the average)

**Qualitative summary:** Amadeus is the only Technology-sector name in the selection, and among the three it carries the highest P/E (19.01, just under the 20x cutoff) and the highest leverage (Debt/Equity 78.6%, still well within the 100% threshold). Search results did not surface specific growth catalysts (e.g., new contracts, segment performance) or company-specific risk events beyond routine stock-quote listings, so no additional qualitative detail can be responsibly added beyond the screened data.

**Momentum assessment:** RSI at 57.72 sits comfortably in neutral-to-firm territory — above the oversold threshold with no overbought signal, indicating balanced but constructive momentum. The price trading roughly 6.8% above its 50-day moving average is the widest gap of the three names, suggesting the most pronounced short-term uptrend among the group.

---

## 2. Logista (LOG.MC) — Industrials

**Fundamentals:** ROE 42.49% (highest in the group), ROA 2.39% (lowest in the group — the wide gap between ROE and ROA is consistent with high leverage-driven return dynamics or an asset-light/distribution business model), P/E 16.80, Debt/Equity 10.2% (lowest in the group by a wide margin)
**Technicals:** RSI 49.95; price €35.28 vs. MA50 €34.88 (≈1.1% above the average)

**Qualitative summary:** One search result characterized Logista as a "fortress-balance-sheet logistics moat whose earnings swing with ECB rates and tobacco's managed decline," paid back to investors via a "near-7% dividend." This framing is consistent with the screened data: very low Debt/Equity (10.2%) supports the "fortress balance sheet" description, while the low ROA (2.39%) despite a very high ROE (42.49%) is consistent with a low-margin, high-turnover distribution business (tobacco and pharma logistics) rather than leverage-driven returns, given the minimal debt load. The reference to tobacco's "managed decline" flags a structural, sector-level risk worth noting, though no further detail (volumes, timelines) was available. This is the only specific, source-attributable qualitative insight generated by the searches across all three names.

**Momentum assessment:** RSI at 49.95 is almost exactly neutral — neither overbought nor oversold, indicating a lack of strong directional momentum in either direction. The price is only marginally above its MA50 (≈1.1%), the narrowest margin of the three companies, suggesting the uptrend confirmation is technically valid but weaker/less decisive than for Amadeus or Rovi.

---

## 3. Laboratorios Rovi (ROVI.MC) — Healthcare

**Fundamentals:** ROE 28.65%, ROA 9.44%, P/E 16.38 (lowest in the group), Debt/Equity 15.0% (second-lowest)
**Technicals:** RSI 63.49 (highest in the group); price €59.30 vs. MA50 €57.81 (≈2.6% above the average)

**Qualitative summary:** Search results flag a specific, verifiable risk event: Rovi's shares fell approximately 5% after the company completed a strategic review of one of its business units (following a non-binding proposal received in late June, per the source). One Yahoo Finance data point also showed the stock down roughly 27% year-to-date, indicating that despite currently trading above its 50-day moving average and posting an RSI in firm territory, the stock has faced material weakness over a longer horizon. No details on the nature of the reviewed unit, drug candidates, or clinical/regulatory matters were available in the search results, so none are asserted here.

**Momentum assessment:** RSI at 63.49 is the strongest reading of the three companies — well clear of the oversold threshold and approaching but not yet in classically overbought territory, indicating the most robust short-term momentum in the group. The price is ≈2.6% above its MA50, a moderate uptrend confirmation. Investors should note the apparent tension between strong near-term technical readings and the reported steep YTD decline and unit-review-driven share drop, which underscores that the current uptrend appears to be a recent development rather than a sustained one.

---

## Comparative Snapshot

| Metric | AMS.MC | LOG.MC | ROVI.MC |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sector | Technology | Industrials | Healthcare |
| ROE | 26.47% | 42.49% | 28.65% |
| ROA | 9.64% | 2.39% | 9.44% |
| P/E | 19.01 | 16.80 | 16.38 |
| Debt/Equity | 78.6% | 10.2% | 15.0% |
| RSI(14) | 57.72 | 49.95 | 63.49 |
| Price vs MA50 | +6.8% | +1.1% | +2.6% |

---

## Closing Conviction Ranking

This ranking reflects the internal consistency and balance of the screened metrics plus what limited qualitative context was found — it is descriptive research commentary, not a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold, and does not address position sizing.

**1. Laboratorios Rovi (ROVI.MC)** — Combines the lowest P/E (16.38) in the group with the strongest current momentum reading (RSI 63.49) and low leverage (15.0%). The balance between ROE and ROA (28.65% vs. 9.44%) is the most internally coherent of the three, suggesting the ROE is not primarily leverage-driven. The main caveat is the disclosed unit-review-related share drop and reported steep YTD decline, indicating the current above-MA50 positioning may reflect a recent rebound rather than sustained strength — this warrants closer monitoring rather than dismissal.

**2. Amadeus IT Group (AMS.MC)** — Solid, balanced fundamentals (ROE 26.47%, P/E 19.01 near the filter's ceiling) and the strongest price positioning relative to its MA50 (+6.8%), with neutral-to-firm RSI. The main relative weakness is the highest leverage in the group (78.6% Debt/Equity), though it remains well inside the screen's 100% threshold, and no company-specific catalysts or risks could be confirmed from available search results.

**3. Logista (LOG.MC)** — Screens well on paper (lowest leverage by far, exceptionally high ROE, lowest P/E-to-ROE ratio implied), but the very low ROA relative to ROE, combined with the weakest momentum signals (RSI closest to neutral at 49.95, smallest MA50 premium at +1.1%), suggest a business with thinner operating margins and a less decisive technical trend. The one specific qualitative insight obtained — exposure to "tobacco's managed decline" as a structural earnings driver — introduces a longer-term sector-risk consideration not present for the other two names.

---

**Disclaimer:** This document is a qualitative and technical research summary based on a predefined quantitative screen and limited, largely inconclusive web search results. It does not constitute investment advice, and it does not recommend any purchase, sale, holding decision, or portfolio allocation. All facts stated are drawn directly from the provided screening data or from the search tool outputs; no financial figures, catalysts, partnerships, or clinical/product details have been invented.
